name: mutastic
description: Mutation testing for Java and Rust, for coding agents: the mutastic skill, and a gate in the agent's Stop hook that holds 'done' until the tests catch what the change does.

interface.shortDescription: Check that the tests catch what a Java change does
interface.longDescription: mutastic plants small bugs in the lines a task changed and runs the tests against each. The mutastic skill teaches the loop: read each card, write the test it asks for, prove it with mutastic verify, and propose an ignore when a case can't happen. The gate holds 'done' until the tests catch what the change does, and hands over to you when the agent can't get there.
defaultPrompt: Check that my tests catch what this change does
